anchors: Proposition 1 and Appendix C.4: MLP final layer
Proposition 2 and Appendix C.5: CNN final layer
Proposition 3 and Appendix C.6: transformer-style final layer
source.statement: For the specified output-layer families and parameter assumptions, the average geometry is alpha I + beta 11^T for an elementwise MLP output, I_Cout tensor A + 11^T_Cout tensor B for a convolutional output, and Q(A tensor I_Lout)Q^T for a zero-mean shared transformer output with orthonormal Q; the last structure has at most T distinct eigenvalues.

mlp: h is arbitrary and independent of output-layer parameters
W and b groups are independent; output-coordinate parameters are iid
cnn: convolution filters and biases are independent groups and iid across output channels
h is arbitrary and independent of output-layer parameters
transformer: z=Q(W h+b), with a single shared W operating on T tokens
W and b are independent, zero-mean, and iid within each group

acceptance.proof_reconstruction: symbolic conditional-moment identities recover all three structures and the transformer eigenvalue multiplicity
acceptance.actual_networks: direct Monte Carlo outer products of executable MLP, convolution, and shared-token layers agree with the derived projections within predeclared relative Frobenius tolerances
acceptance.independent_checker: complete finite Rademacher parameter domains independently reproduce all three geometries
acceptance.uncertainty: block-level structural residuals and standard errors are reported
acceptance.negative_controls: non-iid MLP/CNN output parameters and nonzero-mean transformer weights must violate their corresponding projected structures
acceptance.exit_behavior: verifier exits nonzero unless all certificates, actual networks, independent checks, and control rejections pass
